title: Composition of affine and geometric residue data
statement:
The Lean declaration `picard_residue_homology_compose_data` packages a strictly simpler algebraic step used by the chosen geometric maps proof.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem picard_residue_homology_compose_data {I : Type u} {Ksrc A C : Type v} {Tgt B D : I → Type v} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup C] [AddCommGroup Ksrc] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (Tgt i)] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (B i)] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (D i)] (eK : Ksrc ≃+ A) (eC : ∀ i, Tgt i ≃+ B i) (map : ∀ i, Ksrc → Tgt i) (e : A ≃+ C) (ei : ∀ i, B i ≃+ D i) (F : ∀ i, A → B i) (G : ∀ i, C → D i) (hdata : ∀ i z, eC i (map i z) = F i (eK z)) (hgeom : ∀ i z, ei i (F i z) = G i (e z)) : ∀ i z, (eC i).trans (ei i) (map i z) = G i ((eK.trans e) z)
